# YOLOv7 (no-decode)

Object Detection · `yolov7_640x640_nodecode` · DX-APP C++ example

Object Detection model, evaluated on COCO.

**Input** 640 × 640 × 3 · **Dataset** COCO · **License** GPL-3.0 · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](../../../../python_example/object_detection/yolov7/yolov7_640x640_nodecode/model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models yolov7-wo_decoding
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target yolov7_640x640_nodecode_sync   # once
./bin/yolov7_640x640_nodecode_sync \
  -m assets/models/yolov7_640x640_nodecode.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_street.jpg
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/object_detection/yolov7/yolov7_640x640_nodecode/yolov7_640x640_nodecode_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/yolov7_640x640_nodecode.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_street.jpg
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | mAP |
|---|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 50.81 |
| Q-Lite | 50.58 (−0.23) |
| Q-Pro | 50.62 (−0.19) |

COCO · difference vs Raw in brackets.
